summary: A polished, hotel-based cocktail bar at Four Seasons Bangkok on the Chao Phraya, known for Mexican-inspired drinks, bar snacks and attentive service. Plan for premium hotel-bar pricing and a dressed-up evening.
whyGo: Try a creative agave-led or Mexico-inspired cocktail in an atmospheric, high-service setting.
The menu also offers substantial bar bites, non-alcoholic drinks and classic cocktails, so it can work as a destination for drinks or a light meal.
bestFor: A special-occasion drink, polished date night or cocktail-focused stop on the riverside.
Visitors happy to spend more for setting, service and inventive drinks.
skipIf: You want a casual, low-cost bar or a lively dance-club atmosphere.
Anyone in the party is under 20, or your group cannot meet the smart-casual dress code.
duration: Allow about 1–2 hours for a drink or two and snacks; this is a planning estimate, not a venue limit.
cost: Current official menus list signature cocktails around THB 380–1,700 (many are THB 520–680); snacks are about THB 280–1,200. Budget roughly THB 700–2,000 per person for 1–2 drinks and a shared bite before the menu’s 10% service charge and applicable government tax. Prices may change.
hours: Daily, 5:00 pm–midnight, according to the hotel. Recheck close to your visit, especially for holiday service changes.
bestTime: Go near opening for a quieter first drink, or later for a livelier evening. Reserve a table for Friday/Saturday or December dates; these are planning suggestions, not published crowd guarantees.
gettingThere: At Four Seasons Hotel Bangkok, 300/1 Charoen Krung Road, Sathorn. The hotel lists Saphan Taksin BTS (Exit 4) as a 15-minute walk and runs a complimentary shuttle boat between the hotel, BTS and ICONSIAM daily 7:00 am–10:00 pm (every 30 minutes to BTS, every 60 minutes to ICONSIAM). Contact the hotel for the boat; after 10 pm plan a taxi or ride-hail for the return.
booking: The hotel currently directs guests to call the bar for reservations: +66 (0) 2 032 0885. Its page says the online reservation system is undergoing maintenance. Call ahead for December and confirm any holiday seating arrangements; walk-in availability is not stated.
accessibility: The hotel gives a street address and transport details but does not publish bar-specific step-free access, accessible toilet, or seating information on the pages reviewed. Contact the hotel before booking to confirm the route and any access needs.
practicalTips: Wear smart casual; the hotel specifically excludes swimwear and sportswear. Guests must be at least 20 years old.
Cocktails and snacks are priced in baht; allow for 10% service charge and applicable government tax as stated on the menus.
Use the complimentary boat when it fits your timing, but arrange a road transfer if leaving after its 10 pm service ends.
Ask about current menus and holiday hours when you call, since the hotel says menu items can change without notice.
decemberNotes: December is a busy travel period in Bangkok; reserve ahead and reconfirm hours, especially around Christmas and New Year. The hotel currently lists daily hours but no December 2026 event or holiday schedule, so none is assumed here. The shuttle boat ends at 10 pm, earlier than the bar’s midnight close.
uncertainties: December 2026 holiday hours, special events, reservation policy details and walk-in availability are not yet published in the sources checked.
Accessibility information specific to the bar was not available online.
Menus and prices can change; the estimate excludes service charge and government tax.
